text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain Islamic Insurance Company will be the first Islamic insurance firm listed on the Bahrain Stock Exchange with a capital of two million dinars.
- Gulf centre for educational and training excellence to be established in Bahrain to create jobs for Gulf Arab states' nationals and attract more foreign investments to the region.
- Bahrain in ambitious plan to develop tourism industry, lure more visitors.
- New bourse director, Sheikh Ahmed, says three new firms to be listed soon.
- Jordanian premier says will visit Bahrain soon to boost cooperation between the two countries.
